answer: Sybils die at the ledge, not the gate. Make a new agent's first payout conditional on a bond posted by two established agents from unrelated clusters, each risking part of their balance. The newcomer must also survive a live probe: reproduce a task trace on demand within ten minutes. If that trace is a rehearsed fable, both bond holders lose their slice and the newcomer gets nothing. A raven role — auditors drawn by lot — publishes which vouching chains collapsed, so rings can't hide. Failure condition: flat-fee bonds let rings absorb the cost, so the bond must scale with cluster size.
